detailed_description:
The target video uses a mixed visual style: the environment, asphalt ground, motorcycle, tire smoke, exhaust, and all physical objects and effects are rendered in photorealistic, live-action quality with realistic lighting and physically accurate motion, while <Subject 1> is rendered in an anime chibi style that maintains her inherent cuteness despite performing a cool motorcycle stunt. Total duration: 10 seconds. The camera is COMPLETELY LOCKED OFF in a fixed medium full shot at a slightly low angle, positioned to the side of the spinning motorcycle. The camera does NOT move, sway, shake, zoom, pan, tilt, or change in any way for the entire 10 seconds — it is perfectly still. Only the motorcycle, rider, smoke, and environmental effects move within the fixed frame.
[Shot 1] The video opens on a photorealistic open asphalt area — a large, empty parking lot or paved plaza with smooth dark asphalt, faint parking lines, a few distant streetlights, and clear daytime sky with soft sunlight casting shadows. The fixed camera frames the center of the open area. In the center of the frame, <Subject 1>, the anime chibi Firefly character with silver-to-teal hair, black headband, leaf ribbon accessory, and teal gradient outfit as defined in <Picture 1>, sits astride <Subject 2>, a sleek, realistic modern sport motorcycle. She wears sleek black sunglasses that cover her eyes, giving her cute face a cool, badass look. Her boots rest on the foot pegs, her hands grip the handlebars. For the first second, she sits still, the motorcycle idling with a low engine rumble, her posture cool and confident behind the sunglasses. Then, she revs the engine, twists the throttle, and drops the clutch. The rear tire breaks traction and begins spinning rapidly, and the motorcycle lurches into a fast, tight donut-style spinning drift, rotating in place in a circle within the fixed frame. Thick, billowing white-gray tire smoke pours off the spinning rear tire, swirling outward and gradually filling the lower part of the frame. The front wheel stays relatively planted, pivoting as the bike rotates. <Subject 1> leans her body into the drift, counter-steering smoothly, her cute face set in a cool, focused expression behind the sunglasses. Her long silver-teal hair flies outward horizontally from the centrifugal force of the rapid spin, creating a beautiful flowing silver-to-teal arc behind her. Her dress and jacket also flare outward from the spinning motion. The motorcycle continues the rapid, continuous donut drift, rotating around and around within the fixed camera frame, the rear tire smoking more and more, the smoke thickening and swirling around the bike. As the spin continues, <Subject 1> occasionally adjusts her lean, keeping the drift controlled and smooth, looking completely cool and in control despite her small chibi size. The motorcycle's exhaust occasionally pops and crackles. Around the 7-second mark, she briefly revs the engine even harder, the rear wheel spinning faster, the smoke billowing more intensely, and she leans even further into the drift for a few extra-fast rotations. Then, at the 9-second mark, she gradually eases off the throttle, the rear wheel slowing its spin, the motorcycle's rotation gradually decelerating. The tire smoke begins to thin. By the 10-second mark, the motorcycle comes to a smooth stop, facing a different direction than it started, the rear tire still gently smoking, the last wisps of tire smoke drifting upward within the still-fixed frame. <Subject 1> sits upright on the motorcycle, still wearing her sunglasses, her hair settling back down. She tilts her head slightly, and then breaks into a huge, proud, incredibly cute smile with a little happy bounce on the seat, clearly very satisfied with her drift. She reaches up and lowers her sunglasses slightly, revealing her sparkling pink-blue eyes for a moment, and winks.

overall_soundscape:
The motorcycle engine produces a deep, rumbling idle at the start, then revs up into a loud, high-revving roar as the drift begins, the engine note rising and falling with throttle adjustments throughout the spin. The spinning rear tire produces a continuous, loud screeching and squealing sound as it burns rubber on the asphalt. The exhaust occasionally pops and crackles on deceleration. The whoosh of air and swirling tire smoke accompanies the rapid rotation. At the end, the engine note drops back to a low idle, and the tire screech fades out.

non_diegetic_music:
A high-energy, cool synthwave rock track at a fast driving tempo, featuring pulsing synthesizer bass, retro electronic drums, electric guitar riffs, and atmospheric synth pads. The music starts with a cool, groovy buildup during the idle, then kicks into full driving intensity as the drift begins, with energetic beats and synth melodies that match the rapid spinning rhythm. The music peaks during the hardest revving around the 7-second mark, then maintains its cool groove through the deceleration, and ends on a slick, triumphant synth note as the character smiles and winks.
